people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: So all those who were counted of the children of Israel by their fathers’ houses, from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war in Israel—
translations.bsb: So all the Israelites twenty years of age or older who could serve in Israel’s army were counted according to their families.
translations.kjv: So were all those that were numbered of the children of Israel, by the house of their fathers, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war in Israel;
translations.asv: So all they that were numbered of the children of Israel by their fathers' houses, from twenty years old and upward, all that were able to go forth to war in Israel;
